title: SAM2 interactive correction prompt views
hypothesis: Across four tracked objects, a shared positive-negative correction-pair radius plus per-object/frame midpoint and Givens angle will retain direct-click corrected J&F within 1 pp while reducing serialized correction-history bytes by at least 25%; report full session bytes and test against native 8px-grid click coding.
physical_object: SAM2 per-object interactive click history for a video session
mirror_coordinate: For each object, a shared correction-pair radius and a per-frame Givens angle, addressed around the current correction-pair midpoint
logical_multiplicity: Per-object positive/negative click pairs across frames reconstructed from one shared pair geometry and a small frame View code
insertion_point: Coordinate history immediately before SAM2 add_new_points_or_box; the decoder reconstructs click coordinates before the official prompt encoder
controls: official SAM2 direct positive/negative click corrections from current-frame errors
Mirror polar pair code with shared per-object radius
per-frame exact mask corrections as quality upper control

scene.human_correction_simulation: At each current frame, choose one positive point from false negatives and one negative point from false positives using only that frame's ground truth and current prediction; no future frame or mask is read.

development.selection_metric: Freeze per-object shared pair radii as the mean half-distance between direct correction pairs on the development world; no audit tuning.

storage.authority: actual serialized correction-history payload and actual serialized resumable SAM2 session bundle bytes
paid_objects: video frame cache retained by inference state

compute.active_compute: SAM2 propagation plus click encoding/decoding and correction calls; report per-video wall time and click count

success_gate: Across all three fresh worlds, Mirror corrected mean J&F is within 1 pp of direct clicks, correction-history payload is at least 25% smaller than direct float32 clicks, and Mirror has either better J&F than 8px-grid clicks at equal/lower prompt bytes or at least 1 pp better J&F with no more than 2x their prompt bytes. Full session bytes are reported separately.
failure_gate: Mirror misses the direct-click quality or prompt-history byte gate in at least two fresh worlds, or the 8px-grid native control dominates Mirror on both prompt bytes and J&F.
boundaries: human correction prompts simulated from current-frame ground truth only
no natural-video, benchmark, or GPU claim
this test compresses prompt history, not the number of human corrections
